ev.erbe_verfall.erholt.liste.text: The World Heritage Committee removes {ad} from the List of World Heritage in Danger. Its condition stands at {zustand, number} out of 100.
ev.erbe_verfall.erholt.offen.text: After the emergency works, the heritage authority reopens {ad} to visitors. Its condition stands at {zustand, number} out of 100.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.kapital: There is not enough capital for the contract.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.keine: There is no restoration for this site.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.laeuft: The restoration is already under way.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.verwaltung: The administration is stretched to capacity.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.vorne: The restoration is already at the front; there is no building capacity.
ev.erbe_verfall.grund.vorziehen: This needs {k} administrative capacity; {hat} is available.
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.abwarten.label: Do nothing
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.notsicherung.ausgang: Emergency works at {ad}: its condition now stands at {zustand, number} out of 100.
Scaffolding, roofs, supports: {n} points at once, and the site stays open. If it stays below the threshold, the authority will report again.
Scaffolding, roofs, supports: {n} points at once, and the committee holds off. If the site stays below the threshold, it will report again.
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.notsicherung.label: Order emergency works
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.restaurierung.ausgan: The restoration of {ad} has been put out to tender.
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.restaurierung.beschr: The building project from Culture › Sites: {d} points after about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. The authority keeps the site open until then.
The building project from Culture › Sites: {d} points after about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. The committee waits for it to finish.
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.restaurierung.label: Put the restoration out to tender
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.vorziehen.ausgang: The restoration of {ad} moves forward; {n, plural, =0 {it is now next in line.} one {one project is still ahead of it.} other {# projects are still ahead of it.}}
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.vorziehen.beschr: It moves to the front of the building queue, and {n, plural, one {one project waits} other {# projects wait}} longer instead.
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.vorziehen.kosten: Costs {k} administrative capacity ({n, plural, one {# project overtaken} other {# projects overtaken}}).
ev.erbe_verfall.opt.vorziehen.label: Move the restoration forward
ev.erbe_verfall.provinz: In {provinz}: tourism −{tourismus, number, 1}{erhaltung, select, 0 {} other {, preservation of cultural heritage −{erhaltung, number, 1}}}.
ev.erbe_verfall.schliessung.abwarten: The site is closed to visitors: visitors and prestige decline.
ev.erbe_verfall.schliessung.standard: The heritage authority closes {ad} to visitors.
ev.erbe_verfall.schliessung.text1: The heritage authority in {ort} sounds the alarm: {ad} is decaying, its condition stands at {zustand, number} out of 100, against {start, number} when you took office. Without emergency works, the site will be closed to visitors.
ev.erbe_verfall.schliessung.text2: Tour operators and archaeologists are watching. Every closed site drops out of next season's programmes.
ev.erbe_verfall.schliessung.titel: The heritage authority wants to close {ad}
ev.erbe_verfall.steckt: The restoration was contracted long ago but has not started: {n, plural, =0 {there is no building capacity.} one {one project is ahead of it in the building queue.} other {# projects are ahead of it in the building queue.}}
ev.erbe_verfall.streichung.abwarten: The committee deletes the site from the World Heritage List: a lasting loss of prestige and visitors.
ev.erbe_verfall.streichung.standard: UNESCO deletes {ad} from the World Heritage List.
ev.erbe_verfall.streichung.text1: {ad|anfang} is on the List of World Heritage in Danger, and its condition has fallen further: {zustand, number} out of 100, against {start, number} when you took office. The committee is considering deleting the site from the World Heritage List.
ev.erbe_verfall.streichung.text2: UNESCO has deleted sites from the list before, most recently Liverpool in 2021.
ev.erbe_verfall.text2.minderheit: Communities, churches and governments abroad watch closely how Türkiye treats this heritage.
ev.erbe_verfall.warnung.abwarten: The committee puts the site on the List of World Heritage in Danger: prestige and visitors decline.
ev.erbe_verfall.warnung.standard: The World Heritage Committee puts {ad} on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
ev.erbe_verfall.warnung.text1: UNESCO's World Heritage Committee is reviewing {ad}{mitort, select, ja { in {ort}} other {}}: its condition stands at {zustand, number} out of 100, against {start, number} when you took office. Without a conservation plan, the site goes on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
ev.erbe_verfall.warnung.text2: That list holds sites whose survival is threatened. Anyone who still does nothing risks deletion.
ev.erbe_verfall.warum: A site is reported once it has fallen below its threshold of {schwelle} and has lost at least {verlust} points since you took office. Upkeep and heritage protection prevent this.
welle_h3.gs.erbe_verfall: The decay of a heritage site
welle_h3.gs.zentralbank_vertrauen: The doubts about the central bank
welle_h3.medien.ausgang.gescheitert: The attempt fails ({grund}). The campaign by "{blatt}" carries on unchecked.
welle_h3.medien.opt.abwarten.beschr: The campaign goes on, and "{blatt}" gains readers.
welle_h3.medien.opt.abwarten.label: Keep silent
welle_h3.medien.opt.aufsichtsstrafe.besc: Penalties against "{blatt}": the campaign ends, but the press freedom score falls and the outlet gains sympathy.
welle_h3.medien.opt.interview.beschr: You go where the attack comes from. "{blatt}" then reports more gently for a while.
welle_h3.medien.opt.interview.label: Give "{blatt}" an interview
welle_h3.medien.opt.pressekonferenz.besc: You take every question. The campaign loses momentum but does not go away.
welle_h3.medien.opt.verfahren.beschr: Complaints against journalists at "{blatt}": the campaign ends, but the press freedom score falls and it is noticed abroad.
welle_h3.medien.opt.verfahren.label: Have proceedings opened against the newsroom
welle_h3.medien.rest: Part of the campaign remains: {prozent, prozent, 0} of its damage.
welle_h3.medien.standard: The government keeps silent. The campaign by "{blatt}" takes hold, and the outlet gains readers.
welle_h3.medien.text1.arbeit: For weeks "{blatt}" has led with unemployment: {wert, prozent, 1} out of work, and not a word from the government. You have not taken a single question from the press in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_h3.medien.text1.inflation: For weeks "{blatt}" has led with the cost of living: {wert, prozent, 1} inflation, and not a word from the government. You have not taken a single question from the press in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_h3.medien.text1.korruption: Week after week "{blatt}" runs new stories about cronyism and contracts for the government's friends. You have not taken a single question from the press in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_h3.medien.text1.stil: "{blatt}" accuses you of governing over the country's head: no press conference, no interview, only statements. You have not taken a single question in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_h3.medien.text1.wohnen: "{blatt}" leads with the housing shortage: families in containers, rents nobody can pay any more. You have not taken a single question from the press in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_h3.medien.text2: The outlet reaches {anteil, prozent, 0} of the audience. With a press freedom score of {rsf, number, 1} (rank {rang}), many people believe it. {wer} advises you to stop keeping silent.
welle_h3.medien.warum: Anyone who leaves the media alone for {monate, plural, one {a month} other {# months}} hands them the story. The bigger the audience of the critical outlets and the freer the press, the harder a campaign hits.
welle_h3.st.lage.gefaehrdet.titel: On UNESCO's List of World Heritage in Danger. Once the site is cared for again, it comes off the list.
welle_h3.st.lage.geschlossen.titel: The heritage authority has closed the site. Once it is cared for again, it reopens.
welle_h3.st.lage.gestrichen: Deleted from the World Heritage List
welle_h3.st.lage.gestrichen.titel: UNESCO has deleted the site from the World Heritage List.
welle_h3.stelle.zentralbank.devisen: To the central bank: foreign exchange
welle_h3.stelle.zentralbank.sitzung: To the central bank: rate meeting
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.opt.abwarte: The agency decides without hearing from you, and downgrades.
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.opt.fuehrun: New faces at the top of the bank. The change itself unsettles markets briefly; the new leadership builds confidence.
Independence is written into law. After that you can no longer replace the leadership, and pressure on the rate meeting works only half as well.
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.opt.stuetze: {ergebnis} The agency takes note of the commitment.
A speech for the tough line against inflation. The agency sees support; business grumbles.
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.standard: {agentur} downgrades Türkiye: the central bank lacks the government's backing.
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.text1: {agentur} puts Türkiye on watch: the central bank's credibility is {wort} ({glaub} out of 100) and inflation stands at {inflation, prozent, 1}. Without a clear commitment from the government, a downgrade looms.
welle_h3.zb.glaubwuerdigkeit.text2: You have not said a word about the bank in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. {bank} is waiting for a signal.
welle_h3.zb.grund.gehoert: The economy ministry sees its demand heard.
welle_h3.zb.grund.stuetzen: The economy ministry wanted lower rates and sees you back the bank instead.
welle_h3.zb.grund.uebergangen: The economy ministry feels its demand has been ignored.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.abwarten.besch: The bank stands alone. The business wing resents it, and the markets demand a premium.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.abwarten.label: Keep silent
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.austauschen.be: A leadership close to the government cuts rates. The lira falls and credibility collapses.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.gespraech.besc: A conversation with the bank's leadership. The business wing is satisfied; whatever leaks out costs the bank credibility.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.stuetzen.besch: A speech for the tough line against inflation. The business wing feels passed over.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.opt.stuetzen.label: Back the bank in public
welle_h3.zb.inflation.standard: You keep silent about the bank. The business wing resents it, and the markets demand a premium.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.text1: Inflation stands at {inflation, prozent, 1}, far above the bank's interim target of {ziel, prozent, 1}, and the policy rate at {zins, prozent, 1}. Business associations and {wer} demand a cut and, if need be, a new leadership at the bank.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.text2: You have not taken a position on the bank in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. The markets wonder whether you stand behind it.
welle_h3.zb.inflation.titel: The business wing wants lower rates
welle_h3.zb.sitzung.anders: Next rate meeting in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}: as things stand, {neu, prozent, 1} instead of {regel, prozent, 1}.
welle_h3.zb.sitzung.gleich: Next rate meeting in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}: as things stand, the rate stays at {regel, prozent, 1}.
welle_h3.zb.warum: A central bank the government has not spoken about for {monate, plural, one {a month} other {# months}} stands alone: the markets read the silence, and the business wing fills it.
welle_h3.zb.zins.standard: You keep silent about the bank. The business wing resents it, and the markets demand a premium.
welle_h3.zb.zins.text1: The policy rate stands at {zins, prozent, 1} and inflation at {inflation, prozent, 1}: {real, number, 1} percentage points in real terms. Growth has fallen to {wachstum, prozent, 1}. Business associations and {wer} demand a cut and, if need be, a new leadership at the bank.
welle_h3.zb.zins.text2: You have not taken a position on the bank in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. The bank holds its course, but nobody knows whether you stand behind it.
welle_h3.zb.zins.titel: The business wing wants cheaper money
